newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Huayi applies to offer H or B shares.
newsitem.headline: Huayi applies to offer H or B shares.

text.p: Refrigerator parts maker Huayi Compressor Co Ltd has applied to offer either H shares or B shares to tap overseas investment funds, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

If the China Securities Regulatory Commission gives approval to Huayi to make a B share offer, the B shares will be listed in Shenzhen, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

The scale, timetable and pricing of either issue are not yet decided, the official said. He said Huayi aims to use proceeds from the H or B share offer to step up the output of compressors for freon-free refrigerators.
Huayi, based in Jingdezhen in southeastern Jiangxi province, listed 31.50 million A shares in Shenzhen in June this year.
At that time, a Huayi spokesman said the firm planned to follow the A share listing with an application to offer 100 million B shares.

Huayi has forecast net earnings of 43.40 million yuan for this year, compared with 20.37 million yuan posted in 1995, 10.89 million yuan in 1994 and 6.71 million yuan a year earlier, under Chinese accounting standards.
In an interim report, Huayi said it had unaudited net profits of 17.50 million yuan in the first half of this year, compared with 10.18 million yuan in the year-ago period.
Huayi now has total share capital of 140 million shares, consisting of 105 million legal person shares, 31.50 million A shares and 3.50 million staff shares.
